description: This file defines the GithubSSO class for handling GitHub Single Sign-On (SSO) authentication, including configuration, initialization, token refresh, and testing setup.

classes.name: GithubSSO
classes.description: A class extending SSOBase to implement GitHub OAuth SSO functionality, including login, callback handling, token refresh, and configuration testing.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Returns the name of the SSO provider, 'Github SSO'.

methods.name: getCallbackURL
methods.description: Constructs and returns the callback URL for GitHub OAuth.

methods.name: setSSOConfig
methods.description: Configures the GitHub OAuth strategy with provided settings, including setting up passport strategy and email fetching.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up Express routes for login and callback endpoints for GitHub SSO.

methods.name: testSetup
methods.description: Tests the provided SSO configuration credentials with GitHub.

methods.name: refreshToken
methods.description: Refreshes the OAuth token using the current refresh token.
